implementation.name: Qix (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 90 HDL source files (11 systemverilog, 72 verilog, 7 vhdl) alongside 10 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 12 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 7 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 5 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 7 distinct machine_id rows. license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file and no license grant was found in the HDL headers read (Arcade-Qix.sv, build_id.v). hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 90 source files (11 systemverilog, 72 verilog, 7 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
